text:
```yaml
name: Rust Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  rust-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Package assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/release/your_executable.exe dist/
          # Add any other asset packaging here

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-windows-artifacts
          path: dist/

  rust-web:
    needs: rust-windows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Download artifacts from rust-windows job
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-windows-artifacts
          path: ./dist

      - name: Set up Rust toolchain
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: wasm32-unknown-unknown
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - name: Cache Cargo registry
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-registry-

      - name: Build WASM project
        run: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-web-artifacts
          path: target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/

  deploy:
    needs: rust-web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Download artifacts from rust-web job
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-web-artifacts
          path: ./wasm

      - name: Deploy to production
        run: |
          # Add deployment logic here
          echo "Deploying to production..."
```

This GitHub Actions workflow separates the original `rust.yml` workflow into three jobs: `rust-windows`, `rust-web`, and `deploy`. The `rust-windows` job builds the project for Windows and packages the assets, while the `rust-web` job builds the WASM project and uploads the artifacts. The `deploy` job depends on the completion of the `rust-web` job and is responsible for deploying the application to production.
